check_sketch: attribute access nki.benchmark/baremetal/profile
source: introspection: dir(nki) == [Kernel, debug, jit, simulate, compiler, ...]

rule: Decorate only the top-level kernel with @nki.jit; helper functions called from a kernel must be plain Python functions.
why: Nested decorated functions trigger 'classes need to inherit from nl.NKIObject' errors at the call site.
trigger: @nki.jit on tiled helper functions.
fix: Remove decorators; apply nki.jit(helper) at a standalone call site if needed.
check_sketch: nki.jit-decorated function called inside another nki.jit function

rule: Avoid keyword-only '*' separators, 'is'/'is not' comparisons, list-typed kernel arguments, nested slicing, and non-string dict keys in kernels.
why: The NKI compiler parses a Python subset; these constructs fail at compile time.
trigger: def k(x, *, flag=True); if cfg is None; stride=[1,1].
fix: Use ==/!=, tuples, plain defaults, string dict keys.
check_sketch: AST of kernel contains kwonly separator, Is/IsNot, list args

rule: Use the 0.3.0+ signatures: affine_select(..., offset=) as keyword, register_move(dst, src) with src a VirtualRegister, sendrecv(dma_engine=nisa.dma_engine.*), dma_compute(dst, srcs, reduce_op, scales=None, unique_indices=True), and collective_permute_implicit(channel_ids=[...]) instead of num_channels.
why: Parameter positions/names changed in 0.3.0 and old call sites break silently or loudly.
trigger: affine_select(dst, pattern, offset, cm, ...) positional; register_move(dst, imm=42).
fix: Update call sites per the migration table.
check_sketch: register_move with imm kwarg; sendrecv with use_gpsimd_dma; *_rank_id with num_channels

rule: Replace nisa.tensor_copy_dynamic_src/_dst with nisa.tensor_copy on a .ap(..., scalar_offset=reg, indirect_dim=d) view.
why: The dynamic copy APIs were removed in 0.4.0.
trigger: AttributeError on tensor_copy_dynamic_src.
fix: nisa.tensor_copy(dst=out, src=src.ap(pattern, scalar_offset=idx, indirect_dim=1)).
check_sketch: call to nisa.tensor_copy_dynamic_src/_dst

rule: Rely on 0.3.0+ defaults: nl.ndarray/zeros buffer=nl.sbuf, program_id(axis=0), num_programs(axes=0), iota offset=0, core_barrier engine=gpsimd.
why: Several parameter defaults changed; code passing None for buffer now errors.
trigger: nl.ndarray(shape, dtype, buffer=None).
fix: Omit buffer or pass nl.sbuf.
check_sketch: buffer=None passed to creation ops

rule: Guard version-specific code with nki.compiler.get_compiler_version() (0.6.0 -> major 0, minor 6).
why: Beta/0.x releases change APIs; the version call lets kernels branch.
trigger: Kernels that must run on 0.5 and 0.6.
fix: v = nki.compiler.get_compiler_version(); if v.minor >= 6: use fori_loop.

rule: Run CPU simulation via nki.simulate(kernel)(numpy args) or NKI_SIMULATOR=1, select target with NEURON_PLATFORM_TARGET_OVERRIDE, and use nl.device_print(prefix, tensor) with NEURON_RT_DEBUG_OUTPUT_DIR for on-device dumps.
why: These env vars drive frontend target resolution and runtime debug streams; device_print prefix must be a constant string.
trigger: Simulation on a laptop without target set defaulting to hardware detection.
fix: export NEURON_PLATFORM_TARGET_OVERRIDE=trn2; nki.simulate(kernel[lnc])(...).

rule: Call nisa.get_nc_version()/get_nc_sub_version() inside the kernel to branch per generation (gen2=trn1/inf2, gen3=trn2, gen4=trn3; sub-version 0=trn3pre, 1=trn3).
why: The target context only exists during tracing/compilation.
trigger: Module-level version checks raising 'No backend set'.
fix: if nisa.get_nc_version() == nisa.nc_version.gen4: use exponential/activate2.
check_sketch: get_nc_version called outside @nki.jit body

rule: Avoid nl.divide in hot paths; compute a reciprocal (Vector nisa.reciprocal or Scalar activation) once per row and multiply with tensor_scalar.
why: The api index lists divide as not supported as an ISA op; division lowers to reciprocal + multiply anyway, and the per-partition reciprocal is tiny.
trigger: nl.divide(scores, rowsum_broadcast).
fix: nisa.reciprocal(inv, rowsum); nisa.tensor_scalar(out, scores, nl.multiply, inv).
check_sketch: nl.divide call with a (P,1) divisor
source: nki/api/nki.language.rst ('.. divide : not supported'); nki.isa.reciprocal docstring

rule: Treat nl.* compute wrappers (softmax, rms_norm, matmul, transpose, load_transpose2d, gather_flattened, broadcast_to, where, dropout, ...) as experimental; for production kernels express the same work with nisa instructions and explicit tiles.
why: They are marked <<experimental>> and allocate intermediate tiles implicitly, hiding engine choice and PSUM/SBUF placement.
trigger: Performance or placement surprises from nl.softmax inside a tight loop.
fix: Build softmax from activation(exp, reduce)+reciprocal+tensor_scalar.

rule: Expect nl.var to always return a keepdims=True shape regardless of the keepdims argument.
why: Documented current behavior of the experimental wrapper.
trigger: Shape mismatch after nl.var(x, axis=1, keepdims=False).
fix: Squeeze explicitly or accept (P,1).

rule: Expect nl.copy and tensor_copy without a pre-declared PSUM dst to produce SBUF tiles; declare a PSUM dst explicitly when needed.
why: Default allocation target for copies is SBUF.
trigger: Assuming nl.copy(psum_tile) stays in PSUM.
fix: nisa.tensor_copy(dst=psum_decl, src=...).

rule: Read neuron-profile matmul rows as src=<dtype>@<addr>[strides][nums] dst=... M*K acc_flags=<f> psum_zero=<v>; acc_flags=2 means accumulator reset, and MX operands show as $MX[data,scale,start_scale_partition].
why: The profiler prints compact ISA operand syntax; acc_flags reveals whether accumulation groups were formed as intended.
trigger: Diagnosing unexpected PSUM resets or missing accumulation.
fix: Check acc_flags on consecutive matmuls of one K-loop: only the first should reset.
source: nki.isa.nc_matmul and nc_matmul_mx docstrings, Profiler view syntax

rule: Use nki.compiler.parallel_compile(kernel_specs, compile_opts_dict={'target': ...}, artifacts_base_dir, max_workers) with unique config_ids for sweeping kernel hyperparameters.
why: It compiles variants in worker processes and returns CompilationResult entries with neff_path, times and estimated_utilization.
trigger: Sequential compile loops for autotuning.
fix: Build KernelSpec(kernel_module, kernel_func_name, inputs, outputs, hyperparams, config_id).
